title: PH Origins
style: Grounded, cinematic corporate thriller look: one night in Hawkes Tower, cool artificial light, deep shadows, rain-wet city.
notes: Babylon.js game, GLB-only runtime (phoriginswebsite/AGENTS.md). Materials: generate seamless, then texture.maps or image.normals/image.albedo, then compress into assets/textures. Lore for signs and screens: Hawkes Biomedical, Voss Capital, Liberty Square, Midnight Diner. Never show B3, the vat or the creature on public-facing Hawkes signage.

material.description: A tileable material (walnut, lab tile, painted block...) for the interior kit.
material.prompt: Seamless tileable texture: {prompt}. Flat, straight-on, evenly lit, no shadows, no objects, photographic detail.

sign.description: A poster, ad, store sign or document for the world (Hawkes Biomedical, Voss Capital...).
sign.prompt: {prompt}. Flat, front-on, fills the frame, legible typography, {style}

sky.description: A 360° sky / city panorama for a level's skybox.

screen-loop.description: A short loop for a screen (boardroom TV, station ad, CCTV): give the screen's still as start and end.

prop.description: A textured GLB prop from a reference image (front view, plain background), made from four views: back, left and right are made and checked first (convert/compress before shipping).

splat.description: A 3D Gaussian Splat (.splat, 32-byte Babylon format) and preview PNG for Level 7 (The Train) or environment sets.

bark.description: Pierce's inner-voice barks for a room, written to the story's tone.
bark.prompt: Write short inner-voice barks for Pierce Hawkes (chairman of Hawkes Biomedical, one night in Hawkes Tower) for this moment: {prompt}. Terse, dry, in character. Never mention game mechanics.

kinds._about: What each kind of entity is made of, for the Hawkes Gen library (docs/library.md). phoriginswebsite/hawkes.library.json brings assets/models in: a character or prop per GLB, its model slot the shipped file. Runtime is GLB-only: a made model is converted and compressed before it ships (phoriginswebsite/AGENTS.md). optional: a slot a product may skip (content health leaves it out of what is unmade).

character.description: A character: a concept turnaround and the rigged GLB the game loads (Mixamo rig, fitted in Blender).

concept.description: A full-body turnaround (front, side, back) to model from. Optional: the shipped characters were rigged from Mixamo, not modeled from a concept.

params.prompt: Character turnaround sheet of {look}: front, side and back views, full body, neutral A-pose, plain grey background. {style} {feedback}

model.description: The rigged GLB in assets/models (made by hand: Mixamo rig, Blender).

prop.description: A prop for a level: a reference image and the textured GLB made from it.

reference.description: The prop alone, straight-on front view, evenly lit on a plain background: the front of the four views the model is made from.

params.prompt: A single {look}, straight-on front view, the whole object in frame, evenly lit, plain light grey background, no other objects. Photographic detail, {style} {feedback}

model.description: The textured GLB in assets/models, made from four views of the reference (back, left and right are made and checked first). Convert and compress before shipping.

splat.description: A 3D Gaussian Splat (.splat) environment or backdrop (e.g. Level 7 The Train): a reference image, the 32-byte .splat cloud, and its rendered preview.

reference.description: Wide reference view of the environment to lift or guide the 3D Gaussian splat.

splat.description: The 32-byte .splat binary (for Babylon.js GaussianSplattingMesh) and its preview PNG.

preview.description: Rendered 2D preview PNG of the 3D Gaussian splat cloud (filled automatically when splat is built).
